title: Shield (Hope)

sources.title: Shield (Hope)
markers: A [[Shields|Shield]] with an echantment which grants the wearer an additional +2 to their Armour Class. Despite this, it is simply called 'Shield'.

fields.Availability: Unobtainable in normal play. Hope used it before Patch 6.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
